file_change.purpose: Load and validate functional-set.json as the bounded Design scope for one Planning cycle.
implementation: Load functional-set.schema.json and validate the subset of JSON Schema constructs used by the bootstrap contracts with stdlib-only code.
Verify accepted predecessor shape and exact Design-input revision bindings.
Call design.py to resolve all selected DP statements and reject references outside declared Design inputs.
Return a FunctionalSet object containing scope only; reject Plan-owned fields.
